title: Nick Cannon Sends Strong Message to Kevin Hart
htmlContent:
Last week, Kevin Hart turned 42 and as a belated birthday gift, his former Wild'N Out and Real Husbands of Hollywood castmate, Nick Cannon decided to send him a llama to celebrate the 'Fatherhood' actor's big day. Kevin posted his reaction on Instagram for the world to see with the caption: "Fucking @nickcannon. Best B Day gift ever asshole."

“What am I supposed to do with this f***ing llama? This is the most childish s*** I’ve ever seen in my life,” he shouted in good fun. The comedian then took the llama on a stroll around his backyard and promised to get Nick back for the joke. “Birthday war pranks are on. I swear to God, you have no idea what you’re in store for,” he said.

In the comment section Cannon would reply, "I love you man!!! I’m having all these new kids, I figured you should have a new kid too!! Welcome Lucky The Llama to the family!! #SaveTheDrama4YourLlama."

Happy Belated Birthday Kevin... The gift is hilarious!
